    What does it mean if you have low-carbon?
    When your blood has lower-than-normal CO2, it means the body is removing too much CO2. Low CO2 levels in the blood is sometimes a sign of a health problem such as: Addison's disease. Ketoacidosis, a condition that can affect people with Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes.Jun 13, 2022
